articles.summary: Hey everyone 👋 Mixpanel's annual user conference is back — **MXP 2026** is happening **May 12th in San Francisco** (Terra Gallery). Our CEO Jen Taylor is opening with a keynote on product vision and where analytics is headed in the AI era. We've also got: • Real sessions from product leaders at Olo, Workday, Sprout Social, and Vuori • Hands-on Mixpanel Masters workshops where you bring actual problems and we solve them live • 1:1 "Data Doctors" sessions with Mixpanel experts • Roundtables with other product and data folks tackling similar challenges It's free to attend. The agenda is built for practitioners—no sitting through pitches, you choose your own path based on what you're trying to solve. If you're in the Bay Area or thinking about making the trip, worth checking out: https://bit.ly/48loQ6l Anyone else going?

articles.summary: Hey everyone! Mixpanel's annual user conference is back in San Francisco and it's right around the corner! 📍 MXP 2026 | May 12 | Terra Gallery, SF | Free to attend 🎟️ A full day of sessions for product and data practitioners—hands-on workshops, real talks from teams at Chewy, Sprout Social, Asana, Snowflake, and more, plus a happy hour to close it out. A few things on the agenda worth calling out 🤩 : • Mixpanel Masters: Live sandbox workshops on Experiments and AI • Snowflake keynote on scaling AI programs • Ecommerce panel with Mejuri and others on product strategy I'm most excited for our opening lineup: a company vision from CEO, Jen Taylor (https://www.linkedin.com/in/talkwjt/), a product vision from our CTO, Anant Gupta (https://www.linkedin.com/in/anantgupta1/), and a fireside chat between CRO, Damian Gona (https://www.linkedin.com/in/damian-gona-466ab121/) and Kinjal Shah, Head of Analytics, Experimentation and AI at Chewy (https://www.linkedin.com/in/kinjalkumarshah/). What a way to start the day! 🚀 ↪️ Save your seat (https://mixpanel.com/mxp/san-francisco-2026?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=slack&utm_campaign=MXPSF-OpeningSessions&utm_content=)

articles.summary: 👋 Hey everyone! The Mixpanel EMEA marketing team have been sitting on some data that's too good not to share with this community. We just wrapped up one of our biggest research projects to date, analysing 423 billion user events across global ecommerce operations. The EMEA findings are turning heads and we think every ecommerce leader in this group should see them. Here's everything we've put together, and why it's worth your time: 📊 The 2026 State of Digital Analytics Report We benchmarked ecommerce performance across 8 industries and 4 global regions. EMEA's numbers tell a story that goes deeper than market conditions. • Engagement down 48% YoY • Actions per user is the lowest globally. • Weekly retention nearly 20 points behind APAC The report breaks down exactly what's driving it, what high-performing teams are doing differently, and the metrics that move the needle on acquisition, engagement, stickiness, and retention. → Download the report (https://mixpanel.com/content/benchmarks-2026?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-emea-ecommerce-campaign&utm_content=slack-soda-report). ✍️ What 423 billion events told us about EMEA ecommerce growth If you want the "so what" without diving through the full dataset first, start here. This analysis unpacks the single biggest shift happening across ecommerce right now. The blog covers everything from chasing acquisition volume to building genuine user habits and why EMEA teams are feeling it most. It also explains the difference between metrics that predict durable growth and the vanity metrics that create noise. A quick read that reframes how you think about measurement. Read the blog (https://mixpanel.com/blog/ecommerce-benchmarks-2026/?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-emea-ecommerce-campaign&utm_content=slack-soda-blog). (https://mixpanel.com/blog/ecommerce-benchmarks-2026/?utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-state-of-digital-analytics-emea-ecommerce-campaign&utm_content=2026-state-of-digital-analytics-b2b-blog) ✅ The 2026 EMEA Ecommerce Opportunity: Blind Spot Diagnostic This one's our favorite. It's a one-page checklist built directly from the report findings. Focusing on four areas where EMEA teams are consistently losing visibility without realising it: localisation gaps, measurement failures, retention unknowns, and missed opportunities. It takes about 60 seconds to complete. Most teams find at least one blind spot they weren't expecting. And the good news is, every single one is fixable. → Download the diagnostic checklist (https://userimg-assets.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-141894/1774440511797_SODA_Ecommerce%20Lead%20magnet_One%20pager_01KMJEAYFN43PSR72731PC3MV0.pdf). As always, happy to answer any questions in the thread and would love to hear what resonates with your team. Best, The EMEA Marketing Team
